test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can rectify the incorrectly spelt word in the following sentence.

I doubt that these lifts can accomodate 100 people.
solution: The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e. 'accommodate'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"accommodate"** means to provide space or room for someone or something; to adjust to someone's needs or requirements. (समायोजित करना) • **Example: **The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests. • **"accomodate" **is an incorrect spelling and does not carry any specific meaning. (गलत वर्तनी) • **Example: **This room can accomodate all the guests. (Incorrect spelling) • Hence, we can infer that the correct spelling is **'accommodate'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'accommodate'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **acomodate** (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling of 'accommodate'. • **Example:** This room can acomodate all the guests. (Incorrect spelling) • **accommodatte** (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling of 'accommodate'. • **Example:** The hall can accommodatte a large number of people. (Incorrect spelling) • **accomondate** (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling of 'accommodate'. • **Example:** The venue can accomondate all the participants. (Incorrect spelling) 11a:T1266,
